cards.t: Cysic Bridge Suspended After Unauthorized Mint and Fund Move
cards.b: Cysic suspended its crypto bridge after an attacker made an unauthorized mint of 10 million CYS tokens and moved approximately $727,000 to Ethereum.

per.CYS: Hit by an unauthorized mint of 10 million tokens and bridge suspension.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: The exact total financial damage beyond the bridged $727,000 and recovery plans are not yet specified.

cards.t: Grayscale Files With SEC for First US Bittensor ETP Listing
cards.b: Grayscale has filed an application with the SEC to list the first US Bittensor ETP.

per.TAO: Gaining institutional product visibility via Grayscale's ETP filing.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: The exact filing date and SEC review timeline details are not provided.
